title: Airworthiness Standards: Certification of Transport-Category Aircraft Systems
summary: The FAA proposes revisions to the airworthiness certification standards governing transport-category aircraft systems. The proposal applies to aircraft manufacturers and certificated air carriers that operate transport-category aircraft.
full_text: The Federal Aviation Administration proposes revisions to the airworthiness certification standards that govern the design and approval of transport-category aircraft systems. The proposal updates the certification basis and continued-airworthiness expectations for affected aircraft systems. The requirements apply to aircraft manufacturers seeking type certification and to certificated air carriers that operate transport-category aircraft in commercial service.
